field_test_status: The OraDiscuss Health Check pack has not been run against a real Oracle database. The founder's field test is the designed gate for that. Until it is passed, every asset here is rendered from scripts/showcase/lab/healthcheck/collection.txt.

synthetic_inputs.why: The collection every asset here is rendered from. Written by hand to the shape the pack collector emits. No database was contacted.
The pack config used for the render. Invented SID, invented paths, shipped thresholds.
A lab stub standing in for the listener utility, so the listener row reports a state instead of reporting that the capture machine has no Oracle install. It contacts nothing.
